newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks see-saw to end flat, seen down.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks see-saw to end flat, seen down.

text.p: Pakistani stocks moved both ways before finishing down on Thursday amid speculative trade in antici ation of a package for the revival of the agriculture sector, dealers said.
They said the market might slip lower as the incentives announced for the agriculture sector fell short of market expectations.
The Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) 100-share index fell 0.28 points, or 0.05 percent, to end at 1,603.30. Losers led gainers 194 to 86. Turnover rose to 57 million shares from 46 million on Wednesday.
Bank of Punjab fell 0.75 to 29 rupees and Dewan Salman Fibre 0.10 to 40. Hub Power Co rose 0.20 to 38.15. Pakistan State Oil fell 5.0 to 272 and Shell Pakistan rose 11 to 241.
PTCL rose 0.55 to 31.25. ICI Pakistan fell 0.10 to 25.55 and FFC Jordan Fertilizer 0.20 to 17.80.
